known_limitations: Astra review and a separate merge/promotion gate remain required.
Repository policy can reject branch pushes or PR creation; the controller fails closed rather than bypassing policy.
The controller depends on the repository's GitHub Actions/GITHUB_TOKEN permissions and included capacity; it does not purchase additional Actions or API capacity.
Failure log excerpts are heuristic-sanitized and bounded; raw failed logs stay temporary and are not committed.
The worker-task repository_dispatch integration is a bootstrap/orchestrator recovery modification, not a free-worker-generated file; provenance records this separately.
